description: Source code for SparkConnectServerAppStatusStore class and related data structures, managing session and execution info in Spark SQL connect UI.

classes.name: SparkConnectServerAppStatusStore
classes.description: Manages session and execution data for Spark connect server UI, providing methods to retrieve session/execution lists, counts, and specific session/execution info.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Represents a session's information including timestamps, user ID, and total executions.

classes.name: ExecutionInfo
classes.description: Represents an execution's details including statement, timestamps, state, and associated IDs.

classes.name: ExecutionState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible execution states such as STARTED, COMPILED, READY, etc.

methods.name: getSessionList
methods.description: Returns a sequence of all session information objects.

methods.name: getExecutionList
methods.description: Returns a sequence of all execution information objects.

methods.name: getOnlineSessionNum
methods.description: Returns the number of currently active (online) sessions.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by session ID, if it exists.

methods.name: getExecution
methods.description: Retrieves a specific execution by execution ID, if it exists.

methods.name: getTotalRunning
methods.description: Counts the number of currently active executions.

methods.name: totalTime
methods.description: Calculates total time for a session or execution based on timestamps.

methods.name: isExecutionActive
methods.description: Indicates whether an execution is currently active based on its state.
